Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting vaccinating pregnant women and children with mercury-containing vaccines.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of mercurycontaining vaccines; andadding a new section to chapter 70.95M RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95M RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning July 1, 2006, a person who is known to be pregnant orwho is under three years of age shall not be vaccinated with a mercurycontaining vaccine or injected with a mercurycontaining product thatdoes not meet any existing federal guideline. (2) The secretary of the department of health may, upon declarationof a public health emergency, suspend the requirements of this sectionfor the duration of the emergency.
